Alexander Pope (1688–1744).  Complete Poetical Works.  1903.

Poems: 1718–27

The Curll Miscellanies. VII. Epigram: An Empty House

Y
OU
 beat your Pate, and fancy Wit will come:
Knock as you please, there ’s nobody at home.
